Based on the text provided, Warfarin is an anticoagulant used to prevent the formation of harmful blood clots. Its primary effect is life-saving for patients at high risk of clot formation. However, it requires meticulous monitoring due to significant risks. The side effects and complications mentioned include minor bruising, as well as more severe issues such as bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract or the brain.

Regarding your second question, the largest bone in the human body is the femur, also known as the thigh bone.
